---
title: "Multicolumn"
format:
  typst:
    columns: 2
filters:
  - gallimaufry
extensions:
  gallimaufry:
    multicolumn: true
---

## Column-spanning tables

In a multi-column Typst layout, tables with the `.multicolumn` class span all columns.
The filter injects `scope: "parent"` and `placement` into the Typst `#figure()` call.

Some filler text to demonstrate the two-column layout before the table appears.
